title: Ben Rich called UFOs 'unfunded opportunities'

tellings.quote: you told me once that Ben Rich would refer to UFOs as unfunded opportunities.

plain: Ben Rich, who ran Lockheed's Skunk Works, the company's secret aircraft design shop, is said to have called UFOs "unfunded opportunities" in the 1990s. Michels recalls that the defence writer Nick Cook once told him this. If true, it hints that a top aircraft builder saw UFOs as technology waiting to be paid for and built.
